evidence: Official site uis.edu confirmed. PROGRAMS: real degree titles (BS Accounting, MBA, MS Computer Science, DPA) and the four colleges (Business & Management, Health Science & Technology, Liberal Arts & Social Sciences, Public Affairs & Education) match official catalog.uis.edu. However the 30 real degrees are diluted by ~15 fabricated 'program' entries that are actually news articles, newsletters and CAPE certificates, plus edvoy-aggregator duplicates. Official catalog program counts (catalog.uis.edu/degreesoffered: ~34-38 bachelor / 24-34 master / 1-2 doctoral) contradict the JSON description's '49 bachelor / 51 master'. PRICES: JSON uses flat $24k UG / $26k grad / $28k doctoral with no residency or per-program variation. Official Fall 2026 (registrar/tuition-fees/fall-2026-tuition): non-resident UG $680.00/credit (~$20,400 + fees/yr, ~$24k plausible), non-resident grad $737.25/credit — grad $26k flat is an unverified rough estimate. Tuition is residency/credit-hour based, so flat figures are approximations = stale. SCHOLARSHIPS: names real but amounts wrong — official Star Scholar = $16,000 over 4yr (3.25-3.49 GPA) or $8,000 over 4yr (3.0-3.24), JSON says 'до $7,000/год'; Capital Scholars official $5,000/yr up to full tuition+housing (Chancellor's), JSON says 'до $8,000/год'. CAMPUS: 740-acre Lake Springfield main campus & four colleges accurate; two of three campus entries are junk/empty. ACCOMMODATION: hall names (Lincoln, Founders, Larkin, UIS Apartments) plausible but not verified against current housing pages within fetch budget.
